from cyhole import DexScreener

# Initialize the DexScreener client
dexscreener = DexScreener()

# SPL token mint address (example: USDC on Solana)
mint_address = "EPjFWaJY42ccP3Fmj7GLSe97j4iqFsmjyPipUSp5gAX"

# Retrieve all trading pairs for the token on Solana
pairs = dexscreener.get_pairs(mint=mint_address, chain="solana")

# Print how many pairs were returned
print(f"Number of trading pairs: {len(pairs)}")
